ARISTO_SH1.label: Sh₁
ARISTO_SH1.description: Lower hyperbolic-sine argument u. Read sinh(u) on D with D interpreted as 0.1 to 1; conversely Sh1 gives asinh(D/10). Arguments are dimensionless.

ARISTO_SH2.label: Sh₂
ARISTO_SH2.description: Upper hyperbolic-sine argument u. Read sinh(u) directly on D from 1 to 10; conversely Sh2 gives asinh(D). Arguments are dimensionless.

ARISTO_TH.label: Th
ARISTO_TH.description: Hyperbolic-tangent argument u. Read tanh(u) on D interpreted as 0.1 to 1. The engraved finite range ends at u = 3, before the right D index; tanh(u) never reaches 1 for finite u.

ARISTO_CH.label: Ch
ARISTO_CH.description: Hyperbolic-cosine argument u. Read cosh(u) directly on D from 1 to 10; conversely Ch gives acosh(D). Ch = 0 is at D = 1.

ARISTO_H1.label: H₁
ARISTO_H1.description: Lower hypotenuse range: set x on D interpreted as 0.1 to 1, then read sqrt(1+x^2) on H1. Main range sqrt(1.01) to sqrt(2).

ARISTO_H2.label: H₂
ARISTO_H2.description: Upper hypotenuse range: set x directly on D from 1 to 10, then read sqrt(1+x^2) on H2. Main range sqrt(2) to sqrt(101).

ARISTO_T.label: T
ARISTO_T.description: Tangent/cotangent row. Black tangent and red cotangent arguments sum to 90 degrees at each shared graduation. Read the function value on C interpreted as 0.1 to 1.

ARISTO_S.label: S
ARISTO_S.description: Sine/cosine row. Black sine and red cosine arguments sum to 90 degrees at each shared graduation. Read the function value on C interpreted as 0.1 to 1.

ARISTO_ST.label: ST
ARISTO_ST.formula: θ rad ≈ sin θ ≈ tan θ
ARISTO_ST.description: Radian-calibrated small-angle row: C/100 equals the black angle in radians. Sine and tangent are approximations to that radian value. Red angles are the complements for cosine/cotangent; black and red sum to 90 degrees.

ARISTO_P.label: P
ARISTO_P.description: Reverse Pythagorean row: with the slide aligned, set x on D interpreted as 0.1 to 1 and read sqrt(1-x^2) on P. As P is on the slide, it follows C when the slide moves.

FC284_Y.label: Y
FC284_Y.description: Fixed principal number scale; actual decimal values from 0.1 to 1 on both faces.

FC284_y.label: y
FC284_y.description: Movable principal number scale; actual decimal values from 0.1 to 1 on both faces.

FC284_I.label: 1/y
FC284_I.description: Reciprocal principal scale: reads 10 to 1 while y reads 0.1 to 1.

FC284_A.label: √X
FC284_A.description: Fixed parabolic row: the engraved X equals Y squared. The left caption means Y = sqrt(X).

FC284_B.label: √x
FC284_B.description: Movable parabolic row: the engraved x equals y squared. The left caption means y = sqrt(x).

FC284_BI.label: 1/√x
FC284_BI.description: Reciprocal parabolic row: engraved x equals 1/y squared; y = 1/sqrt(x).

FC284_H.label: √(X²−1)
FC284_H.description: Hypotenuse row: the engraved X is sqrt(1+Y^2). The caption specifies Y = sqrt(X^2-1).

FC284_P.label: √(1−X²)
FC284_P.description: Pythagorean row: engraved X = sqrt(1-Y^2). With sine read on Y, this gives the cosine.

FC284_S.label: sin Xᵍ
FC284_S.description: Sine in gon: Y = sin(pi X/200). There is no complementary-angle overprint; use the Pythagorean row for cosine.

FC284_T.label: tan Xᵍ
FC284_T.description: Tangent in gon: Y = tan(pi X/200). The principal interval stops at 50 gon (45 degrees).

FC284_CH.label: 0.1 cosh xᵍ
FC284_CH.description: Hyperbolic cosine in gon: y = 0.1 cosh(pi x/200). Multiply the y reading by 10 to obtain cosh.

FC284_SH2.label: 0.1 sinh xᵍ
FC284_SH2.description: Upper hyperbolic sine in gon: y = 0.1 sinh(pi x/200). Multiply the y reading by 10 to obtain sinh.

FC284_SH1.label: sinh xᵍ
FC284_SH1.description: Lower hyperbolic sine in gon: y = sinh(pi x/200).

FC284_TH.label: tanh Xᵍ
FC284_TH.description: Fixed hyperbolic tangent in gon: Y = tanh(pi X/200). Stops at 200 gon before the infinite-argument endpoint.

FC284_E.label: (eˣ)*
FC284_E.description: Normalised exponential row for the main hairline: x = ln(10Y), so exp(x) = 10Y. The original displaced auxiliary cursor marks are not reproduced; * marks this adaptation.

FC284_EG.label: (eˣᵍ)*
FC284_EG.description: Normalised gon exponential row for the main hairline: x = 200 ln(10Y)/pi, so exp(pi x/200) = 10Y. * marks the adaptation from the original auxiliary cursor system.

FC284_LL1.label: 10ln X
FC284_LL1.description: Mathema logarithmic function row: Y = 10ln X; the engraved number X is exp(0.1Y).

FC284_LL01.label: −10ln X
FC284_LL01.description: Mathema logarithmic function row: Y = −10ln X; the engraved number X is exp(−0.1Y).

FC284_LL2.label: ln X
FC284_LL2.description: Mathema logarithmic function row: Y = ln X; the engraved number X is exp(Y).

FC284_LL02.label: −ln X
FC284_LL02.description: Mathema logarithmic function row: Y = −ln X; the engraved number X is exp(−Y).

FC284_LL3.label: 0.1ln X
FC284_LL3.description: Mathema logarithmic function row: Y = 0.1ln X; the engraved number X is exp(10Y).

FC284_LL03.label: −0.1ln X
FC284_LL03.description: Mathema logarithmic function row: Y = −0.1ln X; the engraved number X is exp(−10Y).

CHEM_F.description: Air on the left, CO2 on the right; modern ideal-gas calibrations, not the original Hemmi heat-capacity fit.

FF_LNI_M2.label: LnI₋₂
FF_LNI_M2.description: Flying Fish 1017 LnI₋₂: natural-exponential log-log, exponent -1 * D * 10^(-3).

FF_LNI_M1.label: LnI₋₁
FF_LNI_M1.description: Flying Fish 1017 LnI₋₁: natural-exponential log-log, exponent -1 * D * 10^(-2).

FF_LNI_0.label: LnI₀
FF_LNI_0.description: Flying Fish 1017 LnI₀: natural-exponential log-log, exponent -1 * D * 10^(-1).

FF_LNI_1.label: LnI₁
FF_LNI_1.description: Flying Fish 1017 LnI₁: natural-exponential log-log, exponent -1 * D * 10^(0).

FF_LN_M2.label: Ln₋₂
FF_LN_M2.description: Flying Fish 1017 Ln₋₂: natural-exponential log-log, exponent 1 * D * 10^(-3).

FF_LN_M1.label: Ln₋₁
FF_LN_M1.description: Flying Fish 1017 Ln₋₁: natural-exponential log-log, exponent 1 * D * 10^(-2).

FF_LN_0.label: Ln₀
FF_LN_0.description: Flying Fish 1017 Ln₀: natural-exponential log-log, exponent 1 * D * 10^(-1).

FF_LN_1.label: Ln₁
FF_LN_1.description: Flying Fish 1017 Ln₁: natural-exponential log-log, exponent 1 * D * 10^(0).

FF_A1.label: A₁
FF_A1.description: Fixed two-decade square scale; read squares from D and square roots to D.

FF_LG.label: lg
FF_LG.description: Flying Fish linear base-10 logarithm (L), unlike its exponential Ln and LnI rows.

FF_COT.label: cot
FF_COT.description: Complementary red angle on the 1017 tangent row. Opposite T=30 degrees, cot reads 60 degrees; not a second increasing tangent decade.

FF_T_COT.label: T / cot
FF_T_COT.description: Flying Fish paired tangent/cotangent angles, whose readings sum to 90 degrees.

FF_MZ.label: Mz
FF_MZ.description: Molar mass or density setting, 1-100 over the first quarter of the row. Rescale BOTH M settings by the same power of ten when needed.

FF_XZ.label: Xz
FF_XZ.description: Fraction, not percent: 0.2 means 20%. Paired with the eight-decade M pitch for binary mass/mole or ideal additive-volume conversions.

FF_M.label: M
FF_M.description: Molar mass or density setting, 1-100 over the first quarter of the row. Rescale BOTH M settings by the same power of ten when needed.

FF_MZ_XZ.label: Mz / Xz
FF_MZ_XZ.description: Flying Fish fixed mass setting followed by mass fraction. Modern binary-odds calibration shared with the Hemmi study.

FF_M_X.label: M / X
FF_M_X.description: Flying Fish moving mass setting followed by mole fraction. Both masses must use the same decade.

FF_P_KG.label: P kgf/cm²
FF_P_KG.description: Pressure conversion on the common six-decade absolute-pressure coordinate. Gauge and vacuum references use one standard atmosphere.

PICKETT_SQRT.label: Square roots
PICKETT_SQRT.description: Pickett double-length square root: upper and lower branches meet back-to-back on one shared line. Their round-number graduations remain independently positioned.

PICKETT_CBRT.label: Cube roots
PICKETT_CBRT.description: Pickett triple-length cube root: an unruled upper branch followed by a back-to-back middle/lower pair sharing one line. All three branches increase left to right.

A.label: A
A.description: Fixed two-decade square scale; read squares from D and square roots to D.

B.label: B
B.description: Sliding two-decade square scale; read squares from C and square roots to C.

AI.label: AI
AI.description: Inverted two-decade A scale for reciprocal squares.

BI.label: BI
BI.description: Inverted two-decade B scale for reciprocal squares.

K.label: K
K.description: Three-decade cube scale; read cubes from D and cube roots to D.

KI.label: KI
KI.description: Inverted three-decade cube scale for reciprocal cubes.

F5.label: x⁵
F5.description: Five-decade fifth-power scale; read fifth powers from D and fifth roots to D.

R1.label: √₁
R1.description: Square-root branch for radicands in decades 10^(2k) through 10^(2k+1).

R2.label: √₂
R2.description: Square-root branch for radicands in decades 10^(2k+1) through 10^(2k+2).

PICKETT_5R1.label: ⁵√₁
PICKETT_5R1.description: Pickett-style fifth-root branch 1: (10^0 times x)^(1/5), where x is the local C/D reading from 1 to 10.

PICKETT_5R2.label: ⁵√₂
PICKETT_5R2.description: Pickett-style fifth-root branch 2: (10^1 times x)^(1/5), where x is the local C/D reading from 1 to 10.

PICKETT_5R3.label: ⁵√₃
PICKETT_5R3.description: Pickett-style fifth-root branch 3: (10^2 times x)^(1/5), where x is the local C/D reading from 1 to 10.

PICKETT_5R4.label: ⁵√₄
PICKETT_5R4.description: Pickett-style fifth-root branch 4: (10^3 times x)^(1/5), where x is the local C/D reading from 1 to 10.

PICKETT_5R5.label: ⁵√₅
PICKETT_5R5.description: Pickett-style fifth-root branch 5: (10^4 times x)^(1/5), where x is the local C/D reading from 1 to 10.

PICKETT_FIFTH_ROOT.label: Fifth roots
PICKETT_FIFTH_ROOT.description: Pickett-style extension: one unruled fifth-root branch, then two back-to-back pairs on two shared lines. All five branches increase left to right; each keeps its own exact graduations. Not a historical Pickett scale.

F5_PAIR.label: x⁵ / x⁻⁵
F5_PAIR.description: Shared fifth-power ticks: black x^5 from 1 to 100000 and red x^(-5) from 1 to 0.00001. Each black/red pair multiplies to 1, not 100000. x is the local C/D reading. A mathematical extension, not a historical Pickett scale.

P.label: P
P.description: Pythagorean scale sqrt(1-x^2), useful for cosines and right triangles.

S.label: S
S.description: Sine scale, labelled in degrees from asin(0.1) to 90 degrees.

COS.label: COS
COS.description: Cosine scale, labelled in degrees from 0 to acos(0.1).

T1.label: T₁
T1.description: Tangent scale from atan(0.1) to 45 degrees.

T2.label: T₂
T2.description: Upper tangent scale from 45 degrees to atan(10).

ST.label: ST
ST.description: Small-angle sine/tangent scale from about 0.573 to 5.739 degrees.

SH1.label: Sh₁
SH1.description: Low hyperbolic-sine range, aligned with 0.1 through 1 on D.

SH2.label: Sh₂
SH2.description: High hyperbolic-sine range, aligned with 1 through 10 on D.

TH.label: Th
TH.description: Hyperbolic-tangent range, stopping before the asymptote.

H1.label: H₁
H1.description: Low sqrt(1+x^2) range for x from 0.1 through 1.

H2.label: H₂
H2.description: High sqrt(1+x^2) range for x from 1 through 10.

CH.label: Ch
CH.description: Inverse hyperbolic-cosine argument aligned with cosh(u) on D.

THETA_R.label: θR
THETA_R.description: Normalised resistive phase-angle scale for the Pickett N16 electronics face.

THETA_C.label: θC
THETA_C.description: Normalised capacitive phase-angle scale for the Pickett N16 electronics face.

WAVELENGTH.label: λ
WAVELENGTH.description: Normalised wavelength scale, inverse to frequency.

BB_T.label: T
BB_T.description: Absolute temperature from 100 K to 10,000 K.

BB_H_PEAK.label: Hλm
BB_H_PEAK.description: Approximate peak spectral radiant exitance, proportional to T⁵.

BB_Q_TOTAL.label: Q₀–∞
BB_Q_TOTAL.description: Total photon exitance, proportional to T³.

BB_Q_PEAK.label: Qλm
BB_Q_PEAK.description: Approximate peak spectral photon exitance, proportional to T⁴.

BB_EPEAK.label: Eλm
BB_EPEAK.description: Photon energy at the photon-spectrum peak, approximately 3.92069 kT.

BB_NU1_E.label: ν₁
BB_NU1_E.description: Energy-side high-wavenumber branch, exactly reciprocal to λ1.

BB_NU2_E.label: ν₂
BB_NU2_E.description: Energy-side low-wavenumber branch, exactly reciprocal to λ2.

BB_NU1_Q.label: ν₁
BB_NU1_Q.description: Photon-side high-wavenumber branch, exactly reciprocal to λ1.

BB_NU2_Q.label: ν₂
BB_NU2_Q.description: Photon-side low-wavenumber branch, exactly reciprocal to λ2.

BB_HM.label: M(Hλm)
BB_HM.anchorTitle: T: temperature-alignment index at mid-scale (multiplier 3.162277660168). It is a movable reference, not a fixed temperature or physical constant.
BB_HM.description: Peak spectral-energy mantissa multiplier and T alignment index.

BB_QM.label: M(Qλm)
BB_QM.anchorTitle: T: temperature-alignment index at mid-scale (multiplier 3.162277660168). It is a movable reference, not a fixed temperature or physical constant.
BB_QM.description: Peak spectral-photon mantissa multiplier and T alignment index.

F5100_G.label: g
F5100_G.description: F5100 scale g: maximum spectral photon flux density.

F5100_F.label: f
F5100_F.description: F5100 scale f: total photon flux density.

F5100_E.label: e
F5100_E.description: F5100 scale e: wavelength of maximum spectral radiant flux density from Wien's law.

F5100_C.label: c
F5100_C.description: F5100 scale c: Celsius temperature aligned with absolute temperature.

F5100_B.label: b
F5100_B.description: F5100 scale b: maximum spectral radiant flux density.

F5100_A.label: a
F5100_A.description: F5100 scale a: total radiant flux density.

F5100_H.label: h
F5100_H.description: F5100 scale h: wavelength with the red two-decade extension and peak markers.

F5100_J.label: j

gauges.label: c
gauges.title: c = 1.128379167096. Circle-diameter factor: diameter = c times the square root of area, in compatible units. Not the speed of light.

gauges.label: e
gauges.title: e = 2.718281828459. Euler's number, the base of natural logarithms; ln(e) = 1.

gauges.label: π
gauges.title: π = 3.14159265359. Pi, the ratio of a circle's circumference to its diameter.

F5100_J.description: F5100 scale j: logarithmic multiplication scale on the energy side.

F5100_I.label: i
F5100_I.description: F5100 scale i: spectral radiant-flux ratio Hλ/Hλmax, with long-wave extension in red.

F5100_L.label: l
F5100_L.description: F5100 scale l: long-wavelength cumulative radiant-energy fraction.

F5100_K.label: k

gauges.label: c
gauges.title: c = 1.128379167096. Circle-diameter factor: diameter = c times the square root of area, in compatible units. Not the speed of light.

gauges.label: π

F5100_K.description: F5100 scale k: second logarithmic multiplication scale on the energy side.

F5100_M.label: m
F5100_M.description: F5100 scale m: short-wavelength cumulative radiant-energy fraction.

F5100_N.label: n
F5100_N.description: F5100 scale n: short-wave spectral photon-flux ratio.

F5100_P.label: p

gauges.label: c
gauges.title: c = 1.128379167096. Circle-diameter factor: diameter = c times the square root of area, in compatible units. Not the speed of light.

gauges.label: e
gauges.title: e = 2.718281828459. Euler's number, the base of natural logarithms; ln(e) = 1.

gauges.label: π
gauges.title: π = 3.14159265359. Pi, the ratio of a circle's circumference to its diameter.

F5100_P.description: F5100 scale p: logarithmic multiplication scale on the photon side.

F5100_O.label: o
F5100_O.description: F5100 scale o: long-wave spectral photon-flux ratio.

F5100_R.label: r
F5100_R.description: F5100 scale r: long-wavelength cumulative photon fraction.

F5100_Q.label: q

gauges.label: c
gauges.title: c = 1.128379167096. Circle-diameter factor: diameter = c times the square root of area, in compatible units. Not the speed of light.

F5100_Q.description: F5100 scale q: second logarithmic multiplication scale on the photon side.

F5100_S.label: s
F5100_S.description: F5100 scale s: short-wavelength cumulative photon fraction.

F5100_REF_NU.label: ν̄
F5100_REF_NU.description: F5100 back reference: wavenumber, aligned reciprocally with wavelength.

F5100_REF_EV.label: E
F5100_REF_EV.description: F5100 back reference: photon energy aligned with wavelength.

PN3LL0.label: LL₀
PN3LL0.description: Pickett N3 LL0+/LL0− pair. The black value e^(0.001D) and its red reciprocal e^(−0.001D) occupy the same graduation.

PN3LL1.label: LL₁
PN3LL1.description: Pickett N3 LL1+/LL1− paired natural-exponential scale.

PN3LL2.label: LL₂
PN3LL2.description: Pickett N3 LL2+/LL2− paired natural-exponential scale.

PN3LL3.label: LL₃
PN3LL3.description: Pickett N3 LL3+/LL3− paired natural-exponential scale.

PLL1.label: LL₁
PLL1.description: Pickett N4 Syncro LL1. Black 10^(0.001D) and red 10^(−0.001D) share every graduation.

PLL2.label: LL₂
PLL2.description: Pickett N4 Syncro LL2. Positive and reciprocal values share every graduation.

PLL3.label: LL₃
PLL3.description: Pickett N4 Syncro LL3. Positive and reciprocal values share every graduation.

PLL4.label: LL₄
PLL4.description: Pickett N4 Syncro LL4. Positive and reciprocal values share every graduation.

T.label: T
T.description: Double-range tangent scale with lower and upper tangent graduations.

PT.label: Pt
PT.description: Thornton P-t scale, split for sqrt(1+t²).

ISD_ITD.label: ISd/ITd
ISD_ITD.description: Thornton paired inverse sine / tangent correction row.

TD_SD.label: Td/Sd
TD_SD.description: Thornton paired direct tangent / sine correction row.
